title: Paint Fence
description: Count the number of ways to paint a fence with n posts and k colors such that no more than two adjacent posts have the same color.
pseudocode:
1. if n == 0 return 0
2. if n == 1 return k
3. same = 0, diff = k
4. for i = 2 to n:
5.   temp_same = diff
6.   diff = (same + diff) * (k - 1)
7.   same = temp_same
8. return same + diff

steps.note: Initialize variables for n=3, k=2. same (last two same) = 0, diff (last two diff) = 2.
Starting loop at i=2. Store previous diff into temp_same.
i=3. Store previous diff (2) into temp_same.
